==Description==
'''Retro Death''', internally referred to as '''ClassicDeath''', is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]]. This modifier changes the death animation of enemies.

'''Retro Death''' is active in [[Classic Candy Cane Lane]], [[Classic Winter]], [[Classic Forest Camp]], [[Classic Island Chaos]] and [[Classic Castle]], which currently can only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It can also be activated on any mode in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode.

==Effects==
When applied, '''Retro Death''' will make enemies have their limbs detach and collapse upon death.
